identity_impact: Candidate semantic identity covers only canonical meaning-bearing Factor, Model, or Strategy semantics. Immutable revision and assessment envelopes preserve provenance without changing semantic identity; model artifact bytes, training environment, and fit semantics are meaning-bearing.
evidence_level: Typed immutable research candidate records and structural assessments only; never single-run formal metrics, formal validity, or research qualification.
fail_closed_behavior: Reject unknown candidate variants, free-form semantic extensions, non-canonical identities, dangling or mismatched typed revisions, ambiguous semantics, and invalid composition while preserving legacy v1 records without reinterpretation.
